title: Oily Italian Salt Cod Frittata
description: A traditional Sardinian dish featuring salt cod, made into a buttery and bouncy frittata, low in sodium and rich in flavor, using sous-vide for perfect cooking.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and cook the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to release their juices.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the cooked salt cod to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the cooked onion and tomato mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch round baking dish.
Place the dish in a sous-vide water bath at 180 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
Remove the dish from the water bath and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
